Home.title: Report. Track. Change.
Home.subtitle: A civic platform for urban issues — maps, transparency, and institutional response.

trust.transparentHint: Public reports appear without personal data.

how.title: How it works
how.description: From a street-level problem to an institutional response — in four clear steps.
how.step1Body: Describe the issue, add a photo, and pin the location on the map.
how.step2Body: The system suggests category, severity, and the right department.
how.step3Body: Staff are assigned and the report is tracked through to resolution.
how.step4Body: See status, updates, and results in real time.

final.title: Spotted a problem in Prizren?

Legal.updated: Draft outline — August 2026. This text is not legal advice and is not in force until municipal counsel approves it.
Legal.disclaimer: This page is a placeholder structure for legal review. Product notes below describe how the current software is designed to work. They do not create rights, waive rights, name a binding law, set retention periods, or designate an official contact. Do not treat this as a finalized privacy notice until counsel for the Municipality of Prizren has completed it.

privacy.collectBody: This section lists categories of data the current application is designed to handle. It is not a complete inventory, a statement of lawful basis, or a list of processors. Legal review must complete those items before this notice is treated as operative.
privacy.reportsBody: When you submit a report, the application is designed to store a description, category, location, and any photo you attach. The public map and list are designed to show the issue, not your name or email. Whether other fields are stored, shared with staff, or later published must be confirmed in legal review.
privacy.accountBody: If you create an account, the application is designed to store a display name, an email address, and a hashed password when you register with email. If you use a sign-in provider, the application may store that provider’s account identifier. Do not treat this as a complete list of account fields.
privacy.locationBody: Location is used to place a report on the map. Browser geolocation is requested only if you allow it. You may also set a location by other means in the reporting flow, for example by choosing a point on the map. Legal review must define how long coordinates are kept and who can see them.
privacy.imagesBody: Photos you attach to a report are stored with the media host configured for this deployment. A photo may be shown publicly with the report. This outline does not name a binding processor, transfer mechanism, or deletion rule for images; that requires legal review and the actual hosting arrangement.
privacy.cookiesBody: The application uses cookies and similar storage to keep you signed in, remember language, and remember interface preferences such as theme. Advertising cookies are not part of the current product design. This outline is not a complete cookie inventory and does not state a legal basis for storage. Legal review must complete a cookie list and any consent requirements.
privacy.authBody: Sign-in may be offered through email and password and, when enabled in configuration, through third-party providers. The providers below are those the software currently supports. Whether each is enabled in production, and which profile fields are received, depends on configuration and must be confirmed in legal review. Each provider’s own policy governs what that company collects.
privacy.googleBody: If Google sign-in is enabled and you choose it, Google authenticates you. This application may receive an identifier and, if Google provides them, a name and email address. Google’s processing is described in Google’s own privacy policy. This section does not assert Google’s contractual terms, data-processing role, or that Google sign-in is always available.
privacy.appleBody: If Apple sign-in is enabled and you choose it, Apple authenticates you. This application may receive an identifier and, if Apple provides them, a name and email. Apple may offer a private relay email. Apple’s processing is described in Apple’s own privacy policy. This section does not assert Apple’s contractual terms or that Apple sign-in is always available.
privacy.facebookBody: If Facebook sign-in is enabled and you choose it, Facebook (Meta) authenticates you. This application may receive an identifier and, if the provider shares them, a name and email address. Meta’s processing is described in Meta’s own privacy policy. This section does not assert Meta’s contractual terms or that Facebook sign-in is always available.
privacy.retentionBody: Retention periods are not defined in this draft. Legal review must set how long accounts, reports, photos, logs, backups, and related records are kept, and when they are deleted, anonymized, or archived. Do not rely on this page for a retention schedule.
privacy.retentionPlaceholder: Retention schedule (accounts, reports, images, logs, backups) — to be completed by legal review.
privacy.rightsBody: Applicable law may grant rights such as access, correction, restriction, or erasure of personal data. This outline does not assert that a named regulation applies, nor that a specific request process already exists. Legal review must state the applicable law, the lawful bases, and how requests will be handled.
privacy.rightsPlaceholder: Applicable law, lawful bases, and request procedure — to be completed by legal review.
privacy.deletionBody: This draft does not describe an in-app account-deletion control. A user who wants an account removed should use the contact channel once it is designated. Legal review must define the deletion process, identity verification, timelines, and what happens to public reports — for example whether they remain in anonymized form.
privacy.deletionPlaceholder: Account-deletion procedure, verification, and effect on public reports — to be completed by legal review.
privacy.contactBody: The official privacy contact for the Municipality of Prizren has not been designated in this draft. Invented email addresses are not used here. Legal review must publish a real channel before this policy is treated as operative.
privacy.contactPlaceholder: Official privacy contact — to be designated by the Municipality of Prizren after legal review.

terms.useBody: This service is intended for reporting urban and public-service issues in Prizren. Use it in good faith and in accordance with applicable law. This paragraph describes intended use of the current product; it is not a broader license grant.
terms.reportingBody: Submit reports about real infrastructure or public-service problems. Provide information you believe is accurate. Do not use this platform instead of emergency services when immediate official response is required.
terms.prohibitedBody: Do not post illegal content, threats, hate, sexual exploitation, or material that infringes others’ rights. Do not include other people’s unnecessary personal data, such as identity documents or private contact details.
terms.falseBody: Do not submit reports you know are false or misleading. Staff may reject such reports in the product workflow. This page does not invent penalties, fines, or criminal consequences; any further effects are a matter for applicable law and legal review.
terms.abuseBody: Do not attack the service, send spam, use abusive automation, or attempt unauthorized access. Operators may limit or block access they reasonably consider abusive. Exact enforcement rules require operational and legal review.
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for credentials you control and for activity on your account. If you believe the account is misused, use the contact channel once it is designated. This paragraph does not create a monitoring duty beyond what applicable law requires.
terms.publicBody: Reports may be visible to the public, including description, photo, location, category, and status. Do not put information in a report that you are not prepared to see published. Name and email are designed not to appear on the public map or list. Legal review must confirm any exceptions, for example in staff tools.
terms.moderationBody: Municipal or platform staff may update status, assign an institution, mark duplicates, or reject reports they consider outside the purpose of the service or in breach of these terms. This outline does not describe an appeals process; that requires legal and operational review.
terms.availabilityBody: The service may be unavailable because of maintenance, faults, or other causes. This draft does not promise uptime, response times, or that a report will be acted on within a given period.
terms.terminationBody: Operators may close or limit accounts they reasonably consider to violate these terms or to endanger the service or the public. Grounds, notice, and any appeal must be completed by legal review. This paragraph is a placeholder, not a termination policy.
terms.terminationPlaceholder: Termination grounds, notice, and any appeal — to be completed by legal review.
terms.liabilityBody: This platform is a civic reporting channel. It does not replace emergency services. If there is immediate danger, contact official emergency services. This draft does not waive or cap liability. Any limitation of liability, indemnity, or warranty disclaimer must be written by legal counsel and must be valid under applicable law.
terms.liabilityPlaceholder: Limitation of liability, warranties, and indemnities — to be completed by legal counsel. This draft does not waive or cap liability.
terms.contactBody: The official contact for these terms has not been designated in this draft. Legal review must publish a real municipal channel before these terms are treated as operative.
terms.contactPlaceholder: Official terms contact — to be designated by the Municipality of Prizren after legal review.
